content.BPA_clinical_points: Most BPA performed in technically inoperable patients; has been used sequentially for PH persisting after PEA; rescue BPA in unstable patients on ECMO after PEA were ineffective in reported cases.
content.pharmacological_treatment_summary: Optimal medical treatment for CTEPH consists of anticoagulants (lifelong oral VKAs recommended), diuretics and oxygen for heart failure or hypoxaemia. No data exist on efficacy/safety of NOACs for CTEPH.
content.targeted_therapy_rationale: Pulmonary microvascular disease in CTEPH provided rationale to test drugs approved for pulmonary arterial hypertension; targeted therapy justified for technically inoperable patients and for PH persisting after PEA.
content.approved_drugs_for_inoperable_or_persist: Riociguat is the only drug specifically approved for inoperable CTEPH or persistent/recurrent PH after PEA (oral soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator).
content.riociguat_evidence: Prospective randomized trial of 261 patients with inoperable CTEPH or persistent/recurrent PH after PEA showed riociguat significantly increased 6-minute walk distance and reduced PVR.
content.endothelin_antagonists_evidence: In a trial of 157 patients bosentan improved haemodynamics but did not improve exercise capacity or meet primary outcome. Macitentan (dual endothelin antagonist) improved PVR and 6-minute walk distance versus placebo in a phase II trial.
content.ongoing_trials: Riociguat being tested as bridging therapy for patients scheduled for PEA (NCT03273257) and in comparison to BPA (NCT02634203).
content.clinical_uncertainties: Overall effects on clinical worsening from RCTs in CTEPH remain unclear; no data on medical treatment in technically operable patients with prohibitive comorbidities or refusing surgery. Limited prospective data on off-label combinations of PAH drugs in severe haemodynamic compromise.
content.clinical_recommendation_note: Medical therapy is not indicated in symptomatic survivors of acute PE with documented post-thrombotic obstructions but absence of PH at rest (CTED).
